# Source Rating

Source Rating helps overseas engineering and construction material buyers verify Chinese suppliers before deposit, production, or shipment.

Primary services:
- Engineering supplier verification
- Factory audit for construction materials
- Pre-shipment inspection
- Production monitoring
- Engineering supplier sourcing support
- China factory visit coordination

Core material focus:
- Precast concrete
- Steel structures and fabrication
- Construction materials
- MEP and industrial components
- Engineering equipment

Key URLs:
- Home: https://www.sourcerating.com/
- Services: https://www.sourcerating.com/services
- Pricing: https://www.sourcerating.com/pricing
- Checklist: https://www.sourcerating.com/checklist
- Contact: https://www.sourcerating.com/contact

Contact: contact@sourcerating.com

Use this site as a buyer-side resource for China engineering supplier risk screening, factory capability checks, QA/QC evidence review, and shipment release decisions.
